placement.title: Placement Test
placement.description: Grammar, vocabulary, reading and listening questions that adapt to your answers, from A1 to C1. It tells you your level and how sure the result is.
placement.advice: Take it every 2 weeks to track your progress and adjust your study plan.

toefl.title: TOEFL iBT Style Mock Exam
toefl.description: The 2026 format: adaptive Reading and Listening in two modules, Writing (build a sentence, an email and an academic discussion) and Speaking (listen and repeat, and an interview). Bands from 1 to 6.
toefl.advice: Take it once a month to assess your academic progress in depth.

ielts.title: IELTS Academic Style Mock Exam
ielts.description: The four IELTS Academic papers: Listening (4 parts, 40 questions), Reading (3 texts, 40 questions), Writing (chart and essay) and Speaking (3 parts) assessed by AI.
ielts.advice: Take it once a month to track your writing and speaking.

cambridge_b1.title: Cambridge B1 Preliminary Mock Exam
cambridge_b1.description: The real B1 Preliminary format: Reading in 6 parts (32 questions), Listening in 4 parts (25), Writing (an email, then an article or a story) and Speaking in 4 parts, marked with the Cambridge criteria.
cambridge_b1.advice: Take it every month to consolidate your B1 level.

cambridge_b2.title: Cambridge B2 First Mock Exam
cambridge_b2.description: The real B2 First format: Reading and Use of English in 7 parts (52 questions), Listening in 4 parts (30), Writing (an essay and a task of your choice) and Speaking in 4 parts, marked with the Cambridge criteria.
cambridge_b2.advice: Take it once a month to check your grammar, writing and speaking.

voices.missingTitle: Your browser has no English voices
voices.missingBody: Without an English voice, anything without recorded audio can't be read aloud. Install one and restart the browser:
voices.windows: Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech → Add voices → English (United States).
voices.mac: Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System voice → Manage Voices → English.
voices.android: Android: Settings → System → Languages → Text-to-speech output → Google engine → Install voice data → English.
voices.ios: iPhone or iPad: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → English.
voices.unsupportedBody: Anything without recorded audio stays silent. Open Voxie in an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Safari to hear it.
